job.question: In the Police Retirement System of St. Louis (PRS-STL) actuarial RFP, how many years of experience must the principal actuary have?
job.expected_facts: A minimum of five years of professional actuarial experience, plus a minimum of five years of experience testifying before legislative and administrative bodies.
job.acceptance: Five years professional actuarial experience is the core number. A complete description may state the separate five-year testimony requirement; these are not additive ten years and may overlap. Credentials are optional for this question.

reviews.reason: This is an Orange County Employees Retirement System RFP for pension administration project oversight, not the Police Retirement System of St. Louis actuarial RFP. Its five-year requirement applies to a project consultant, not a principal actuary; it does not support the specified actuarial or testimony experience requirements.
quotes: Pension Administration Project Oversight and Consultation Services Request for Proposal September 2023 Orange County Employees Retirement System (OCERS)
Primary consultant performing the work must have a minimum of five (5) years of similar project experience as a consultant with a public defined benefit pension system.
